composition.text: A crust made of iron, magnesium, aluminum, calcium, and potassium.
A dense core at its center.

items.name: Valles Marineris
items.origin: General name of the system of canyons honoring the scientific team of the Mariner 9 program.

items.name: Phlegra Dorsa
items.origin: Named for classical albedo feature at 35N, 195W.

items.name: Amazonis Planitia
items.origin: Classical albedo feature name; home of the Amazons.

items.name: Utopia Rupes
items.origin: Named for calssical albedo feature at 55N, 260W.

items.name: Arcadia Dorsa
items.origin: Named for classical albedo feature at 45N, 120W.

items.name: Tiu Valles
items.origin: Word for "Mars" in old English (West Germanic).

items.name: Hephaestus Rupes
items.origin: Named for classical albedo feature at 20N, 240W.

items.name: Labeatis Fossae
items.origin: Previously named feature at 30N, 75W; expanded coordinates.

items.name: Cerberus Fossae
items.origin: From albedo feature at 10n, 212W. Changed from Cerberus Rupes.

items.name: Syrtis Major Planum
items.origin: Albedo feature name; changed from Planitia to Planum.

items.name: Panchaia Rupes
items.origin: Named for classical albedo feature at 62N, 220W.

items.name: Isidis Dorsa
items.origin: Named for classical albedo feature at 25N, 270W.

items.name: Adamas Labyrinthus
items.origin: Classical albedo feature name; "A River of Diamonds"; today's River Sarbarnarekha in India.

items.name: Granicus Valles
items.origin: Ancient name for river in Turkey.

items.name: Echus Palus
items.origin: Classical albedo feature name, Echus Lacus.

items.name: Ogygis Planum
items.origin: From the nearby classical albedo feature Ogygis Regio.

items.name: Naktong Vallis
items.origin: Modern name for river in the Republic of Korea.

items.name: Scandia Cavi
items.origin: Named for classical albedo feature at 65N, 150W.

items.name: Samara Valles
items.origin: Ancient name for modern Somme River, France.

items.name: Colles Nili
items.origin: From classical albedo feature Portus Nili, at 38N, 295W.

items.name: Al Qahira Vallis
items.origin: Word for 'Mars' in Arabic, Indonesian, Malay.

items.name: Liris Valles
items.origin: Ancient name for modern Liri River, Italy.

items.name: Nanedi Valles
items.origin: Word for "planet" in Sesotho, national language of Lesotho, Africa.

items.name: Thyles Rupes
items.origin: Name and feature changes 1984 from Ultimi Cavi and Thyles Chasma.
